parameters.help_en: The client ID. The system generates a unique ID for each client
parameters.name: client_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the client. To view the unique identifier of an Alibaba Cloud Workspace client, go to the client logon page and click on "About."
parameters.help_zh: 客户端唯一标识。若使用无影客户端，可在客户端登录界面的“关于”面板上查看该参数
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.help_en:
The state of the cloud computer after the OTA update.

>  This parameter is not publicly available. After the OTA update is complete, the state of the cloud computer changes to `RUNNING`.

*   Set the value to running
parameters.help_zh:
指定云电脑升级之后的状态。

> 该参数暂未对外开放使用。目前升级完成后，云电脑状态将变成`RUNNING`
parameters.name: target_status
